sources.title: Do you need a visa? country selector
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The official MFA domain hosts the regional country selector. Direct HTTPS and rendered-page retrieval both timed out at review, preventing a reproducible selected-country result, stable selected-country URL, or backend extraction. Search-indexed prior renderings are not used as a current schedule.

sources.title: Visa requirements for entering the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The official MFA entry page publishes the explicit EU/Schengen nationality waiver and document-conditioned third-country routes. It also timed out during direct and rendered review, so it is not treated as a recoverable current residual nationality schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of EU Member States and signatories of the Schengen Agreement DO NOT need a visa.

sources.title: Law on Foreigners: visa-regime regulation basis
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior of the Republic of North Macedonia / Official Gazette
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Interior Ministry archival publication contains the Law on Foreigners' definition of the visa regime and its basis in a Government nationality regulation. The law itself is not an operative country-by-country schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Визен режим ... е листа на држави чии државјани ... се изземени од таа обврска.
